description:
I possessed a character in a dark, prison-themed BL novel. I became the maid who brings meals to the top ML, who is imprisoned by the bottom ML. Specifically, I’m the one destined to die because the guy escapes. 

"Is there any way you can help me get out?" asked Richard. 

"I have problems with my hearing, so I can't hear you very well," I replied. 

Whenever the imprisoned guy tries to plant a death flag on my neck, a sharp shutdown is what I have to do! I feel bad for the bottom, but I decided to just focus on doing my job. But then...

"Did you say your name was Rosie?" 

Richard’s blue eyes gleamed eerily. "I do not forget what has been done to me. I will make sure to remember everything, including your name." 

I knew I felt uneasy for a reason. Richard escaped. I’m screwed. Now the top is going to kill me...
